lines.t: I thought I had stopped my wrongdoing
I thought I had left my pride behind
I thought I was done with all the sin
All the filth I had within
I know
No one is perfect
No one except you
But I thought I could at least remain faithful to You
I know I did wrong and I repented
But I seem to have again
Forgive me Lord
For all the wrong I've done
For every sin I've tried
To outrun
The tears stream down my face
My heart feels broken in two
I just have to tell all my wrongdoings to you
Help me get past all this
I give you my heart
Humble and submissive
I thought I had stepped out of line
Of all the darkness that tried to define me
But two shadows were all I could see
Yahushua, this is not where I want it to be
I cry unto you, Lord
To forgive all that I've done before, Lord
Lord, forgive me, Lord, for all the wrong I've done, for every sin I've tried to outrun.
The tears stream down my face
My heart feels broken in two
I just have to tell all my wrongdoings to you
Help me get past all of this
I give you my heart, humble and submissive.
I'm sorry
